strengths.text: Dải rộng: diesel 10–5000 kVA, gas 25–2500 kVA; tự sản xuất đầu phát 10–2500 kVA

quote: Xiamen AOSIF Engineering Ltd has focused on R&D and manufacturing of generator sets & alternators since it founding in 2001
The manufacture base is located in Changtai Economic Development Zone with an area of 33,333 square meters
Its product range includes diesel generator sets ranging from 10kVA to 5000kVA, gas generator sets ranging from 25kVA to 2500kVA
ors ranging from 10kVA to 2500kVA
